source_fields.title: Issue #455 R080: exclude malformed archived sweetness-yield evidence [skip netlify]
source_fields.body:
## Authority and source
Owner-authorized #455 Option B safe, Locked-compatible fix; original development parent `3fd001035a6baaaa90927a9d8d02907a14e06435`, engine blob `f3435a05618df3f21caccd6b69530c8b68fe5156`. Owner-approved sweetness-only rule R455-DEC-001, exact five ratings/one control unchanged. No deployment.

## Reproduced source gap
`comparableSweetnessYields` admitted same-coffee archived 0g/negative measured yields and used their taste scores to reverse the next suggested yield or falsely infer a sweetness plateau. Synthetic source counterexamples only; no observed member harm or espresso taste trial.

## Patch
Require prior positive finite measured dose and yield and finite yield/dose ratio before a historical row is eligible for comparable sweetness direction. Original shots, five ratings, notes, recipe families, styles, calibration, feed and Locked 5g/proportional step retained. Four positive/negative/immutability direct-module test groups added to `tests/issue455-yield-step.test.mjs`. Same-commit `docs/workstreams/issue-455.md` receipt and TESTING queue entry `DIC-Q-455-sweetness-comparable-measured-yield-integrity`; no merged SHA or READY claim.

## Verification required
Run exact-source Node22 tests/lint/build, compiled browser/mobile/offline/a11y, isolated SQL/security and approval/governance. Resolve failures before non-force merge; read merged source and exact CI before docs-only READY reconciliation. Original 603 corpus not claimed. No provider/member/production/Netlify writes or visibility changes.
